watchBalance.description: account snapshot followed by a partial event_update - updates arriving while no consumer is awaiting must still reach the object handed to the consumer (same class as issue 26773); frames captured from okx demo trading 2026-10-20
watchBalance.disabledPHP: php arrays are value types - the consumer holds a copy, so updates resolved with no waiter can only be delivered by a client-level queue (see issue 30220)
watchBalance.disabledCS: the typed WatchBalance wrapper copies the dict into a Balances struct at resolve time, freezing the consumer's view - only a client-level queue can deliver later updates (see issue 30220)
watchBalance.disabledGO: since the go typed-returns campaign the WatchBalance wrapper copies the map into a Balances struct at resolve time (NewBalances), freezing the consumer's view - only a client-level queue can deliver later updates (see issue 30220)
watchBalance.disabledRS: the rust Value runtime is copy-on-write (Arc-backed dicts) - the in-place merge detaches from the clone the consumer received at resolve time, and the typed watch_balance wrapper additionally copies into a Balances struct (Balances::from_value), freezing the consumer's view - only a client-level queue can deliver later updates (see issue 30220)
